fields.why: Prevalence is reported and contrasted across many 3+-level SPD variables (race, sexual orientation, marital status, urbanicity, income, employment, insurance, age).
Sex, nativity and veteran status have 2 levels (no entry); region is not an SPD and disability is framed as health status. Marital status as 'other' is defensible.

The blanket two-tailed Z-test statement sits under claims against named referents (Asian/White, straight, married, large central metro, >=400% FPL), giving per-group vs referent only; education is shown only in the table, so side by side.
